events.title: Deck the Hall | Christmas Tree Competition
events.description:
Get ready to deck the halls and show off your holiday creativity!

Deck the Halls is a festive Christmas tree decorating competition where teams, businesses, organizations, and community members can transform a Christmas tree into their own unique holiday masterpiece.

Decorate during the week of thanksgiving and take down is the first week of January. Choose a theme, gather your team, and let your imagination run wild! Whether your tree is traditional and elegant, hilariously over-the-top, or completely unexpected, we want to see what you can create. Then the community gets to vote! Every penny counts as a vote, and the tree with the most votes wins! The winning group get to choose a local nonprofit to receive ALL of the proceeds! Trees will be on display for the community to enjoy.

It’s a fun way to celebrate the holiday season, showcase local creativity, and bring a little extra Christmas magic to the community.

Think you have what it takes to take home the title?

Grab your ornaments, lights, garland, and your best decorating crew—and get ready to Deck the Halls!

Contact Sami at spettey@co.mckenzie.nd.us to enter, and the entry fee is $20.

events.description:
Clay Sculpting Open Studio 👐✨ Join us for a hands-on Clay Sculpting Open Studio where creativity takes shape! Each person receives 1 pound of clay included in the $45 price, with the option to add extra clay for $10 per additional pound.

This is a hand-building experience only—no pottery wheel—just your hands, your imagination, and the tools we provide. Create anything you can dream up! Once your sculpture is complete, we’ll take care of the rest. Your piece will be professionally fired in our kiln, and when it’s ready, you’re invited to return during a Paint Your Own Pottery Open Studio to glaze your creation.

This experience is perfect for both kids and adults, whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned maker. All firings are included in the price, so you can focus on having fun and bringing your ideas to life.

✨ The ideas are limitless—come get your hands dirty and create something truly unique! ✨

Join us for a fun, acapella filled evening with amazing drinks, charcuterie, and desserts along with fun auction items!

Reserve your spot today and join us for an inspiring evening where music, generosity, and hope come together. Together, we can make a difference—one note, one gift, and one life at a time.

Take a little time for yourself during the busy holiday season and enjoy an evening of creativity and relaxation! Join Lorri for a Calming Watercolor Workshop on December 1st from 6–8 PM. This relaxing technique is not only fun to learn, but it's one you can return to again and again! Whether you're new to watercolor or have some experience, this is a wonderful opportunity to slow down, unwind and enjoy a little creative time for yourself.

events.title: Gingerbread House: Display and Contest
events.description:
CONTEST DETAILS Registration deadline: December 5th Gingerbread house drop-off: December 16th Judging and winners announced: December 24th House pick-up: December 26th – January 4th Categories: Littles 5-8 Junior 9-12 Teens 12-17 Adults 18+ Family/Group

GINGERBREAD HOUSE CONTEST RULES Store-bought kits and homemade creations are BOTH welcome! Gingerbread houses must be made of edible materials. All exterior decorations must be edible (candy, icing, cookies, cereal, etc.). Non-edible structural supports are allowed but must be used for support rather than decoration. Each house must be able to stand on its own without being held or supported by a person. All entries must be placed on a sturdy display base for safe transportation and display. Bases do not need to be edible. Entries must be made with ingredients that do not require refrigeration.

Entries must be dropped off by December 16th and remain on display through the judging period. Entries must be picked up between December 26th and January 4th.

PRIZES INCLUDE: $100 in Watford City Bucks sponsored by the Watford City Chamber Of Commerce. FREE ice cream for a YEAR at The Merc! One ceramic piece of your choice to glaze at a Paint Your Own Pottery Open Studio $30 gift card to The Merc Plus, goodies from The Merc! Each category will have ONE winner, selected by Long X Arts Board Members. Gather your supplies, let your imagination run wild, and create a little holiday magic! Whether you go simple, extravagant, traditional or completely outside the box, we can't wait to see all the sweet and creative gingerbread houses our community comes up with! We can't wait to see what you create!

events.title: McKenzie County Day of The Cowboy
events.description:
Celebrate the western way of life with an evening full of cowboy culture, good food, and great entertainment.

Enjoy authentic chuck wagon cooking, gather around the campfire for s'mores, and take in live country music and performances by cowboy poets.

Saddle up and join us for the McKenzie County Day of the Cowboy on Saturday, March 13, 2027, at the McKenzie County Ag Expo! Celebrate the western way of life with an evening full of cowboy culture, good food, and great entertainment. Enjoy authentic chuck wagon cooking, gather around the campfire for s'mores, and take in live country music and performances by cowboy poets.

Whether you're a lifelong cowboy, a fan of western heritage, or simply looking for a unique night out, there's something for everyone to enjoy!

Event Details:

Date: Saturday, March 13, 2027

Location: McKenzie County Ag Expo

Admission: $100 per person | $50 for children 12 and under Meals are included with admission.

Bring your family and friends and experience a celebration of the cowboy spirit, western traditions, and the agricultural heritage that makes our community special.

We look forward to seeing you there! ‍
